_meta._note: Operator description prose consumed by the tool-catalog generator, authored from first-hand TouchDesigner knowledge plus the facts in reference/catalog.json (optype, family, parameter names, menu tokens, defaults).

abletonlinkCHOP: Synchronizes tempo, phase, and beat with peers on the network over Ableton Link.
accumulatePOP: Accumulates or integrates point attributes across frames.
actorCOMP: A rigid or soft body actor participating in a Bullet physics simulation.
addSOP: Creates individual points and polygons, or connects existing points into new primitives.
addTOP: Composites two input images by summing their pixel values, clamping channels that overflow; a simple additive blend often used to brighten or combine light passes.
alembicSOP: Loads geometry from an Alembic (.abc) cache file.
alembicoutPOP: Writes point geometry out to an Alembic cache.
alignSOP: Aligns input geometries to one another by bounding box or transform.
ambientlightCOMP: Adds uniform ambient light to a 3D scene.
analyzeCHOP: Reduces channels to a single statistic per channel such as average, maximum, or length.
analyzePOP: Reduces point attributes to summary statistics.
analyzeTOP: Reduces an image to a single value, row, or column by taking a statistic such as minimum, maximum, or average across the pixels.
angleCHOP: Converts between angle representations, for example degrees, radians, quaternions, and direction vectors.
animationCOMP: A component that holds and edits keyframe animation channels.
annotateCOMP: A resizable comment box for annotating and organizing the network.
antialiasTOP: Smooths jagged, stair-stepped edges in an image with a post-process anti-aliasing filter.
armSOP: Builds or edits an articulated arm/chain of geometry.
artnetDAT: Receives Art-Net DMX universes into a table.
attributeCHOP: Tags channels with attributes such as rotation order or quaternion type that downstream operators respect.
attributePOP: Creates, edits, or removes point attributes.
attributeSOP: Creates, renames, deletes, or edits point, vertex, primitive, and detail attributes.
attributecombinePOP: Combines matching attributes from multiple point inputs.
attributeconvertPOP: Converts an attribute's type or numeric precision.
attributecreateSOP: Adds new attributes to geometry and initializes their values.
audiobandeqCHOP: A multi-band graphic equalizer that boosts or cuts fixed frequency bands of an audio signal.
audiobinauralCHOP: Spatializes audio into a binaural (headphone 3D) mix from source and listener positions.
audiodeviceinCHOP: Captures audio samples from an input device such as a microphone or interface.
audiodeviceoutCHOP: Plays channels as audio out to an output device.
audiodevicesDAT: Lists the available audio input and output devices.
audiodynamicsCHOP: Applies compression, limiting, and gating dynamics to an audio signal.
audiofileinCHOP: Reads audio samples from a file for playback or analysis.
audiofileoutCHOP: Writes audio channels to a sound file.
audiofilterCHOP: Filters an audio signal with low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or band-reject response and an adjustable cutoff.
audiomovieCHOP: Extracts the audio track that accompanies a movie played by a Movie File In TOP.
audiondiCHOP: Sends or receives audio embedded in an NDI stream.
audiooscillatorCHOP: Generates audio-rate tones and waveforms from a frequency input.
audioparaeqCHOP: A parametric equalizer with adjustable center frequency, gain, and Q per band.
audioplayCHOP: Plays back a sound file on demand, often triggered by an event.
audiorenderCHOP: Renders a spatial audio scene from sound sources and a listener into output channels.
audiospectrumCHOP: Computes the frequency spectrum of an audio signal via FFT for visualization or reactivity.
audiostreaminCHOP: Receives streamed audio from the network.
audiostreamoutCHOP: Streams audio channels out over the network.
audiovstCHOP: Hosts a VST audio plug-in and exposes its parameters.
audiowebrenderCHOP: Captures the audio produced by a Web Render TOP.
baseCOMP: A general-purpose container with no panel, used to group and modularize operators.
basisSOP: Edits the parametric basis (knot vector and order) of NURBS curves and surfaces.
beatCHOP: Runs a musical clock locked to a tempo, emitting beat ramps, counts, and pulse triggers.
blacktraxCHOP: Receives real-time position and orientation data from a BlackTrax tracking system.
blendCHOP: Blends multiple input channel sets using weighting channels, for weighted pose or value mixing.
blendCOMP: Blends the transforms of several object components by weight, a weighted parent.
blendPOP: Blends point attributes between inputs by weight.
blendSOP: Blends point positions between topologically matching inputs by weight, for shape interpolation.
blobtrackCHOP: Reports tracked blob positions and sizes as channels.
blobtrackTOP: Detects bright blobs in an image and reports their positions and sizes, a lightweight optical tracker for interactive installations.
blurTOP: Applies a Gaussian or box blur; the filter width parameter sets how many pixels are averaged together.
boneCOMP: A single bone within a skeletal hierarchy for character rigging.
bonegroupSOP: Creates point groups based on skeletal bone capture regions.
booleanSOP: Computes boolean union, intersection, or difference between solid meshes.
boxPOP: Generates points arranged as a box.
boxSOP: Generates a box or cube with adjustable size and divisions.
bridgeSOP: Builds a skin surface bridging between edge loops or profiles.
bulletsolverCOMP: The Bullet dynamics solver that advances a rigid-body physics simulation.
buttonCOMP: A clickable button panel widget that emits a state value.
cachePOP: Buffers frames of point data for replay.
cacheSOP: Holds a buffer of geometry frames in memory for replay.
cacheTOP: Stores a rolling buffer of recent frames on the GPU so earlier frames can be replayed or sampled by a Cache Select.
cacheblendPOP: Blends between cached frames of point data.
cacheselectPOP: Selects a specific cached frame of point data.
cacheselectTOP: Reads a chosen frame out of a Cache TOP's stored buffer by index.
cameraCOMP: A 3D camera defining the view and projection used to render a scene.
capSOP: Caps the open ends of tubes and surfaces with flat or rounded faces.
captureSOP: Assigns capture weights binding geometry points to a skeleton for skinning.
captureregionSOP: Defines the capture influence region of a bone.
carveSOP: Cuts, slices, or extracts portions of curves and surfaces along their parametric coordinates.
channelmixTOP: Rebuilds each output channel as a weighted mix of the input channels, useful for channel swaps and custom color matrices.
choptoDAT: Writes CHOP channels into a table of samples.
choptoPOP: Creates points from CHOP channel data.
choptoSOP: Creates or drives geometry from CHOP channels, for example animating points from channel data.
choptoTOP: Converts CHOP channels into an image, writing sample values into pixels so numeric data can be visualized or fed to shaders.
chromakeyTOP: Keys out a chosen background color (green/blue screen) to produce an alpha matte for compositing.
circlePOP: Generates points arranged on a circle.
circleSOP: Generates a circle or arc as a curve or polygon.
circleTOP: Draws a filled or outlined circle or ellipse directly as an image.
claySOP: Deforms a surface by pushing and pulling its control points like modeling clay.
clipCHOP: Plays back recorded channel clips with control over rate and range.
clipDAT: Holds clip metadata in table form.
clipSOP: Clips geometry against a plane, keeping one side or splitting at the cut.
clipblenderCHOP: Blends and sequences animation clips into a continuous motion stream.
clockCHOP: Outputs wall-clock time components such as hours, minutes, seconds, and frame.
compositeCHOP: Overlays and combines channels from multiple inputs, aligning them in time.
compositeTOP: Layers many inputs together with a selectable blend operation, the multi-input equivalent of the two-input Over/Add TOPs.
connectivityPOP: Labels points by which connected component they belong to.
constantCHOP: Produces channels that hold constant values you type in.
constantMAT: An unlit material that shades surfaces with a single flat color and alpha.
constantTOP: Outputs a flat image of one solid color and alpha at the chosen resolution.
containerCOMP: A panel container that lays out other panels for building user interfaces.
convertDAT: Converts between table and text representations such as CSV, TSV, and free text.
convertSOP: Converts geometry between types such as polygon, mesh, NURBS, and Bezier.
convolveTOP: Filters the image with a user-defined convolution kernel supplied as a small matrix, for custom sharpen/blur/edge effects.
copyCHOP: Repeats or copies the first input's channels once per sample of a second input.
copyPOP: Copies points onto other points or with transforms, for instancing.
copySOP: Copies geometry onto template points or with a stack of transforms, the core instancing/stamping SOP.
cornerpinTOP: Warps the image by dragging its four corners to arbitrary positions, the standard keystone/quad-warp for projection alignment.
countCHOP: Counts threshold crossings or triggers on its input and outputs the running total.
creepSOP: Slides and deforms geometry so it crawls along the surface of another.
cropTOP: Extracts a rectangular sub-region of the image, changing the output to that crop.
crossCHOP: Cross-fades between two channel sets by a blend amount.
crossTOP: Cross-dissolves between two inputs by a single blend amount.
cubemapTOP: Assembles or rearranges the six faces of a cubemap for environment mapping and reflections.
curvePOP: Generates a curve described by points.
curveclaySOP: Sculpts curves by pulling their control points.
curvesectSOP: Finds intersections between curves and surfaces, outputting the crossing points.
cycleCHOP: Repeats a channel a number of times, optionally blending the seams into a seamless loop.
dattoCHOP: Reads a DAT table and turns its rows or columns into channels.
dattoPOP: Builds points from the rows of a DAT.
dattoSOP: Builds geometry (points and primitives) from the rows of a DAT table.
deformSOP: Deforms captured geometry to follow its skeleton (the skinning deform step).
delayCHOP: Delays channels by a fixed time offset.
deleteCHOP: Removes selected channels or trims samples by name pattern or range.
deletePOP: Deletes points selected by group or condition.
deleteSOP: Deletes points or primitives selected by group, number, or bounding volume; its per-element filter expression is withheld from this data-only surface.
depthMAT: Shades surfaces by their depth for use in depth passes and effects.
depthTOP: Extracts the depth buffer from a Render TOP so scene distance can be used for fog, depth-of-field, or masking.
differenceTOP: Outputs the absolute per-pixel difference between two inputs, handy for change detection.
dimensionPOP: Measures or sets the bounding dimensions of the point set.
directdisplayoutTOP: Sends the image to a directly attached display bypassing the desktop compositor for low-latency output.
directxinTOP: Receives a shared GPU texture from another application via DirectX shared surfaces.
directxoutTOP: Publishes the image as a shared DirectX texture for another application to read.
displaceTOP: Offsets each pixel's lookup position using a second image as a displacement map, warping the picture.
divideSOP: Subdivides, triangulates, or bricks polygons to change their tessellation.
dmxfixturePOP: Maps points to DMX lighting fixtures.
dmxinCHOP: Receives lighting-control data (DMX over Art-Net or sACN) as channels.
dmxmapDAT: Defines a mapping of DMX channels to named slots.
dmxoutCHOP: Sends channels out as DMX lighting-control data.
dmxoutPOP: Sends point data out as DMX.
edgeTOP: Detects edges by measuring local contrast, producing an outline image.
embossTOP: Produces a raised, embossed relief look by shading from local intensity gradients.
engineCOMP: Runs an exported .tox component in a separate process via TouchEngine for isolation and scaling.
envelopeCHOP: Follows the moving amplitude envelope (peak or RMS) of a signal.
environmentlightCOMP: Provides image-based environment lighting for physically based rendering.
errorDAT: Collects the errors and warnings reported by operators in the project.
etherdreamDAT: Controls an Ether Dream laser DAC.
evaluateDAT: Evaluates an expression for each cell of a table; its expression-carrying parameters are withheld from this data-only surface, leaving the non-code controls.
eventCHOP: Turns discrete events into channels with lifespans and shapes.
examineDAT: Inspects variables and objects for debugging; its expression parameter is withheld from this data-only surface.
expressionCHOP: Applies a per-channel math expression; note that the code-carrying expression value is withheld from this data-only surface, leaving its scope and naming parameters.
extendCHOP: Sets how each channel behaves before its first and after its last sample (hold, cycle, mirror, or default).
extrudePOP: Extrudes point geometry to add depth.
extrudeSOP: Extrudes faces or edges to add depth and beveling.
facetPOP: Adjusts normals and faceting of point geometry.
facetSOP: Controls normals and faceting, uniquing points and cusping edges for flat or smooth shading.
fanCHOP: Fans a single channel out to many, or folds many channels into one, by index.
fbxCOMP: Imports an FBX scene, bringing in its geometry, materials, and hierarchy.
feedbackCHOP: Feeds its own prior output back for recursive, frame-delayed channel processing.
feedbackPOP: Feeds point output back for recursive, frame-delayed processing.
feedbackTOP: Feeds a downstream result back into the graph one frame later, the building block for trails, accumulation, and reaction-diffusion loops.
fieldCOMP: A text-entry field widget for user input.
fieldPOP: Creates or samples a spatial field over points.
fifoDAT: A first-in-first-out table that drops the oldest rows as new ones arrive.
fileinCHOP: Reads channel data from a file or URL.
fileinDAT: Reads text or a table from a file or URL.
fileinSOP: Loads geometry from a file such as OBJ.
fileoutCHOP: Appends or writes channels to a file.
fileoutDAT: Writes the contents of a DAT to a file.
filletSOP: Creates rounded fillet surfaces or curves between two inputs.
filterCHOP: Low-pass smooths channels over time to remove jitter, with an adjustable filter width.
fitSOP: Fits a NURBS curve or surface through a set of points.
fitTOP: Resizes and fits the input into the output resolution with a chosen fit/stretch mode.
flipTOP: Flips or mirrors the image horizontally and/or vertically.
folderDAT: Lists the files and folders of a directory as a table.
forceSOP: Defines a force field that particle and metaball systems respond to.
forceradialPOP: Applies a radial (attract/repel) force to points.
fractalSOP: Displaces points with fractal noise to roughen a surface.
functionCHOP: Applies a mathematical function (trigonometric, logarithmic, power, and so on) to each channel.
geometryCOMP: Places SOP geometry into the 3D scene with a transform, material, and render flags, the object node that a Render TOP draws.
gestureCHOP: Records a motion and replays it as a reusable gesture channel.
glslMAT: A fully custom material driven by GLSL vertex and pixel shaders, with the shader source supplied through referenced DATs.
glslPOP: Runs a GLSL compute program over points, with the program source supplied through a referenced DAT.
glslTOP: Runs a custom GLSL fragment shader over the output pixels, with the shader source supplied through a referenced Text DAT rather than an inline code value.
glsladvancedPOP: A multi-buffer GLSL point operator for advanced compute workflows, sourced from referenced DATs.
glslcopyPOP: Uses a GLSL program to drive copying or instancing of points.
glslmultiTOP: A GLSL fragment shader TOP that exposes multiple image inputs for multi-texture effects.
glslselectPOP: Selects points using a GLSL program.
gridPOP: Generates points arranged on a grid.
gridSOP: Generates a flat grid of points or polygons with adjustable rows and columns.
groupPOP: Groups points by condition or region.
groupSOP: Creates named point or primitive groups by pattern, number, or bounding region; its per-element filter expression is withheld from this data-only surface.
handleCHOP: Solves handle-based inverse kinematics for character rigs.
handleCOMP: An interactive manipulation handle in the 3D viewport.
histogramPOP: Computes a histogram of an attribute's values.
hogCHOP: Deliberately consumes cook time to profile and stress-test performance.
hokuyoCHOP: Reads distance samples from a Hokuyo laser range scanner.
holdCHOP: Samples the first input and holds that value whenever a second trigger input fires.
holeSOP: Turns enclosed faces into holes in their surrounding face.
hsvadjustTOP: Shifts hue and scales saturation and value, the go-to color-grade for tint and vibrance.
hsvtorgbTOP: Interprets the input channels as HSV and converts them to RGB.
importselectPOP: Selects and imports a subset of point data.
inCHOP: The input tap of a CHOP component.
inDAT: The input tap of a DAT component.
inMAT: The input tap of a material component.
inPOP: The input tap of a POP component.
inSOP: The input tap of a SOP component.
inTOP: The input tap of a TOP component, exposing an external image inside the subnetwork.
infoCHOP: Exposes another operator's numeric info (cook time, sample counts, and status) as channels.
infoDAT: Reports another operator's metadata and info as a table.
insertDAT: Inserts rows or columns into a table; its replace expression parameter is withheld from this data-only surface.
insideTOP: Keeps the first input only where the second input's matte is opaque (source-in compositing).
interpolateCHOP: Interpolates smoothly between successive input channel sets or keyframes.
inversecurveCHOP: Solves an inverse-kinematics curve for smooth chain bending.
inversecurveSOP: Computes an inverse curve solution for chained geometry.
inversekinCHOP: Solves two-bone inverse kinematics from a goal position.
isosurfaceSOP: Builds a surface at a constant value of an implicit 3D function.
joinCHOP: Joins channels end to end in time to build a longer sequence.
joinSOP: Joins multiple curves or surfaces into single continuous primitives.
jointSOP: Creates a skeleton of joints and bones for rigging.
joystickCHOP: Reads axes and buttons from a joystick or game controller.
jsonDAT: Parses JSON and extracts values by path (the JSONPath filter is kept as data); its Python expression parameter is withheld from this data-only surface.
keyboardinCHOP: Reports the pressed state of keyboard keys as channels.
keyboardinDAT: Logs keyboard key events into a table.
keyframeCHOP: Holds an editable keyframe animation and evaluates it into channels.
lagCHOP: Adds inertia, lag, and slew-rate limits so channels ease toward new values.
laserCHOP: Prepares path data for laser projection output.
laserdeviceCHOP: Drives a laser projector DAC with prepared laser channels.
latticeSOP: Deforms geometry by moving the points of a surrounding lattice cage.
layermixTOP: Blends stacked layers with per-layer opacity and blend modes.
layoutTOP: Tiles multiple inputs into a single grid image, sized by rows and columns.
lensdistortTOP: Adds or removes barrel/pincushion lens distortion.
leuzerod4CHOP: Reads distance data from a Leuze ROD4 laser scanner.
levelTOP: Adjusts brightness, contrast, gamma, black/white levels, and opacity, the workhorse tone control.
lfoCHOP: A low-frequency oscillator generating sine, ramp, square, and pulse waves for animation.
lightCOMP: A 3D light source (point, cone, or distant) illuminating a rendered scene.
limitCHOP: Clamps channel values to a range and optionally quantizes them to a step.
limitPOP: Clamps point attributes to a range.
limitSOP: Places geometry (spheres, boxes, or templates) at data points or value limits.
lineMAT: A material for rendering lines and wireframes with width and color control.
linePOP: Generates points arranged on a line.
lineSOP: Creates a straight polyline between endpoints with a chosen number of points.
linemetricsPOP: Measures line length and related metrics per point.
lineresamplePOP: Resamples polylines into evenly spaced points.
linesmoothPOP: Smooths polylines to reduce sharp variation.
linethickSOP: Gives polylines thickness, converting them to ribbons or tubes.
listCOMP: A scriptable list or grid panel widget for rows of items.
lodSOP: Switches between level-of-detail versions of geometry based on viewing distance.
logicCHOP: Performs boolean logic and comparisons across channels, outputting on/off results.
lookupCHOP: Uses the first input as an index into the second input's lookup table.
lookupTOP: Remaps each pixel through a lookup table supplied as a second image, driving color grades and gradient mapping.
lookupattributePOP: Looks up attribute values using an index attribute.
lookupchannelPOP: Samples a CHOP channel per point as a lookup.
lookuptexturePOP: Samples a texture (TOP) per point to read colors or data into attributes.
lsystemSOP: Grows procedural plants and fractals from an L-system rule set.
ltcinCHOP: Decodes SMPTE linear timecode from audio into time channels.
ltcoutCHOP: Encodes time channels as SMPTE linear timecode audio.
lumablurTOP: Blurs by an amount that varies with local luminance, so bright or dark regions smear more.
lumalevelTOP: Adjusts levels based on luminance, useful for isolating highlights or shadows.
magnetSOP: Deforms geometry within a falloff region using a metaball-shaped magnet.
materialSOP: Assigns a material to geometry primitives.
mathCHOP: Performs arithmetic and range remapping on channels (add, multiply, from/to ranges).
mathPOP: Performs arithmetic and range remapping on point attributes.
mathTOP: Performs per-pixel arithmetic (add, multiply, difference, and more) between inputs and constants.
mathcombinePOP: Combines attributes together with a math operation.
mathmixPOP: Mixes attributes by a blend factor.
matteTOP: Applies one input as the alpha matte of another to cut out a shape.
mediafileinfoDAT: Reports metadata (codec, resolution, duration) about a media file.
mergeCHOP: Combines the channels of several inputs into one output.
mergeDAT: Merges tables or text from several inputs, by rows or columns.
mergePOP: Merges several point sets into one.
metaballSOP: Creates metaballs that blend into smooth blobby surfaces.
midieventDAT: Logs incoming MIDI events as table rows.
midiinCHOP: Brings MIDI notes and controllers in as channels.
midiinDAT: Logs incoming MIDI messages into a table.
midiinmapCHOP: Maps incoming MIDI messages to named channels via a mapping table.
midioutCHOP: Sends channels out as MIDI notes and controllers.
mirrorTOP: Reflects the image about a chosen axis to build kaleidoscopic symmetry.
monitorsDAT: Lists the connected display monitors and their properties.
monochromeTOP: Collapses color to a single grayscale channel using a chosen luminance weighting.
mouseinCHOP: Reports mouse position and button state as channels.
mouseoutCHOP: Drives the system mouse position from channels.
moviefileinTOP: Loads and plays back a movie or still-image file, with parameters for the file path, playback rate, and trim.
moviefileoutTOP: Records the incoming image stream to a movie or image-sequence file; this bridge only wires it up, the user triggers the actual recording.
mqttclientDAT: An MQTT client that publishes and subscribes to topics.
multiplyTOP: Multiplies the pixel values of its inputs, a modulate/darken blend.
multitouchinDAT: Reports multi-touch contact events as a table.
ndiDAT: Lists the NDI video sources available on the network.
ndiinTOP: Receives video over the network as an NDI source.
ndioutTOP: Publishes the image on the network as an NDI stream.
neighborPOP: Finds neighboring points within a radius or count.
noiseCHOP: Generates coherent procedural noise channels over time.
noisePOP: Applies coherent noise to point positions or attributes.
noiseSOP: Displaces points with animated coherent noise.
noiseTOP: Generates procedural noise images (Perlin, simplex, and others) with animatable transform and harmonics.
normalizePOP: Normalizes vector attributes or rescales values to a range.
normalmapTOP: Derives a tangent-space normal map from a height or grayscale image for surface detail lighting.
notchTOP: Plays and controls a Notch effects block (.dfxdll), exposing its exposed parameters.
nullCHOP: A pass-through tap, the recommended stable endpoint for exports and references.
nullCOMP: A pass-through object transform used as a stable parent or tap in the object hierarchy.
nullPOP: A pass-through tap for point chains.
nullSOP: A pass-through tap, the recommended stable endpoint of a geometry chain.
nullTOP: A pass-through placeholder used as a stable tap point at the end of an image chain.
objectCHOP: Outputs the transform or relationship (position, rotation, distance) between two 3D objects.
objectmergeSOP: Pulls in geometry from other SOPs by path, optionally applying their object transforms.
opencolorioTOP: Applies an OpenColorIO color-space transform for color-managed pipelines.
opfindDAT: Searches the network and lists operators matching name, type, or property criteria.
optitrackinCHOP: Receives rigid-body and marker data from an OptiTrack motion-capture system.
opviewerCOMP: Embeds another operator's viewer inside a panel.
opviewerTOP: Renders another operator's node viewer into an image so any operator can be seen as a TOP.
oscinCHOP: Receives OSC messages and maps their values to channels.
oscinDAT: Receives OSC messages as table rows.
oscoutCHOP: Sends channel values out as OSC messages.
oscoutDAT: Sends table rows out as OSC messages.
outCHOP: The output tap of a CHOP component.
outDAT: The output tap of a DAT component.
outMAT: The output tap of a material component.
outPOP: The output tap of a POP component.
outSOP: The output tap of a SOP component.
outTOP: The output tap of a TOP component, exporting an image out of the subnetwork.
outsideTOP: Keeps the first input only where the second input's matte is transparent (source-out compositing).
overTOP: Composites the first input over the second using standard alpha-over blending.
overrideCHOP: Passes through whichever input changed most recently, letting several controllers share one output.
packTOP: Packs pixel data into a specific layout or bit format for transport or GPU readback.
panelCHOP: Exposes a panel component's interaction values (state, click, roll) as channels.
pangolinCHOP: Controls Pangolin laser software from channels.
pantiltCHOP: Computes pan and tilt angles to aim a device at a target.
parameterCHOP: Reads the evaluated values of an operator's parameters into channels.
parameterCOMP: A component that presents custom parameters as a user-interface panel.
parameterDAT: Exposes an operator's parameters as an editable table of names and values.
particlePOP: A GPU particle simulation advancing points under forces and rules.
particleSOP: A legacy CPU particle system driven by forces and collisions.
patternCHOP: Generates a shaped pattern across samples (ramp, Gaussian, sine, and more).
patternPOP: Generates a shaped pattern of values across points.
pbrMAT: A physically based material using metalness, roughness, and texture maps for realistic lighting.
performCHOP: Exposes real-time performance statistics such as frame time and cook counts as channels.
performDAT: Reports frame-by-frame performance data as a table.
phaserCHOP: Produces a phase-offset animation signal, shifting channel phase over time.
phaserPOP: Applies a phase-based offset that animates values across points.
phongMAT: A classic Phong-shaded material with diffuse, specular, and emission; its GLSL multi-texture expression parameter is withheld from this data-only surface.
photoshopinTOP: Links live to a Photoshop document, bringing its layers in as an image.
pipeinCHOP: Receives channels over a TCP pipe from another process.
pipeoutCHOP: Sends channels over a TCP pipe to another process; its script-carrying parameter is withheld from this data-only surface.
planePOP: Generates points arranged on a plane.
pointPOP: Edits point positions and attributes directly.
pointSOP: Edits point positions and attributes directly, including creating standard attributes.
pointfileinPOP: Loads a point-cloud file (such as PLY) into points, the entry point for scanned data.
pointfileinTOP: Loads point-cloud file data into a texture where each pixel encodes a point's position or attribute.
pointgeneratorPOP: Generates a specified number of points to seed a system.
pointspriteMAT: Renders points as camera-facing textured sprites.
polygonizePOP: Builds polygonal surface geometry from points.
polyloftSOP: Lofts polygon surfaces across a series of cross-section curves.
polypatchSOP: Builds a smooth spline patch from a polygon control mesh.
polyreduceSOP: Reduces polygon count while preserving overall shape.
polysplineSOP: Fits smooth splines through polygon edges to round them off.
polystitchSOP: Stitches together seams and cracks between polygon surfaces.
poptoCHOP: Reads POP point attributes into channels.
poptoDAT: Writes POP attributes into a table.
posistagenetCHOP: Receives PosiStageNet stage-tracking positions as channels.
prefiltermapTOP: Pre-convolves an environment map into the mip levels a PBR material needs for glossy reflections.
primitivePOP: Edits primitive-level attributes of point geometry.
profileSOP: Extracts and edits profile curves lying on surfaces.
projectSOP: Projects curves onto a surface to create profile curves.
projectionPOP: Projects points using a projection mapping.
projectionTOP: Converts between projection layouts such as equirectangular, cubemap, and fisheye.
proximityPOP: Computes proximity and nearest-neighbor relationships between points.
pulseCHOP: Emits pulse spikes at a set interval or count.
quantizePOP: Snaps point attributes to a grid or step size.
railsSOP: Sweeps cross-section curves along one or two rail curves.
rampTOP: Generates linear, radial, or circular gradients from an editable color ramp.
randomPOP: Assigns random values to point attributes.
rayPOP: Projects points onto a target surface along rays.
raySOP: Projects points onto a target surface along a ray direction, a shrink-wrap.
recordCHOP: Records incoming channels into a buffer that can be replayed.
rectanglePOP: Generates points arranged as a rectangle.
rectangleSOP: Creates a rectangle curve or polygon.
rectangleTOP: Draws a filled or outlined rectangle with adjustable size, position, and corner rounding.
refineSOP: Refines curves and surfaces by adding points or raising their order without changing shape.
remapTOP: Warps the first input by looking up coordinates stored in a second input's pixels.
renameCHOP: Renames channels using from/to name patterns.
renderTOP: Renders 3D geometry from a camera with lights and materials into an image, the heart of the 3D-to-2D lane.
renderpassTOP: Adds an extra render pass (such as a separate layer or buffer) to a Render TOP.
renderpickCHOP: Picks 3D geometry under given coordinates in a render and returns the hit position and info as channels.
renderpickDAT: Reports 3D pick results (hit geometry and position) as a table.
renderselectTOP: Selects one output buffer or pass from a multi-output Render TOP.
rendersimpleTOP: A one-node render that bundles a camera, light, and geometry for quick 3D previews.
renderstreaminCHOP: Receives control data from a disguise RenderStream session.
reorderCHOP: Reorders the channels within the stream.
reorderDAT: Reorders the rows or columns of a table.
reorderTOP: Rearranges, duplicates, or fills the RGBA channels from the inputs.
replaceCHOP: Replaces channels in the first input with matching-named channels from the second.
replicatorCOMP: Creates and maintains one copy of a template operator per row of a table; its script-carrying parameter is withheld from this data-only surface.
rerangePOP: Remaps an attribute from one value range to another.
resampleCHOP: Resamples channels to a new sample rate or time range.
resampleSOP: Resamples curves into evenly spaced points or segments.
resolutionTOP: Resamples the image to a new resolution using a chosen filter.
revolvePOP: Revolves a profile of points around an axis to form a surface.
scalabledisplayTOP: Applies a Scalable Display Technologies warp-and-blend calibration for multi-projector setups.
screenTOP: Composites two inputs with the Screen blend mode for a brightening effect.
screengrabTOP: Captures the desktop or a display region into an image.
selectCHOP: References channels by name from another CHOP anywhere in the project.
selectPOP: References points from another POP by path.
serialCHOP: Reads and writes a serial (RS-232/USB) device as channels.
serialDAT: Reads and writes text to a serial device.
sharedmeminTOP: Reads an image from a shared-memory block written by another process.
sharedmemoutTOP: Writes the image into a shared-memory block for another process to read.
shiftCHOP: Shifts a channel forward or backward in time.
shuffleCHOP: Reshapes the layout between channels and samples (transpose-like operations).
skinPOP: Skins a surface across point curves.
skinSOP: Builds a skin surface across a set of profile curves.
skindeformPOP: Deforms points to follow a skeleton (skinning).
sliderCOMP: A one- or two-dimensional slider panel widget.
slopeTOP: Computes the local gradient (slope) of the image, often a precursor to normal maps or edge shading.
socketioDAT: A Socket.IO client for real-time web messaging.
soptoCHOP: Reads SOP point or primitive attributes into channels.
soptoDAT: Writes SOP attributes into a table.
sortCHOP: Sorts channels or their samples by value or name.
sortPOP: Sorts points by value, position, or attribute.
spectrumTOP: Transforms the image to and from its frequency spectrum via FFT for frequency-domain filtering.
speedCHOP: Integrates a speed channel into position, or scales the flow of time.
spherePOP: Generates points arranged on a sphere.
sphereSOP: Generates a sphere as polygons, mesh, or NURBS.
sprinklePOP: Scatters points across a surface or through a volume.
st2110deviceCHOP: Exposes audio and ancillary data of an ST 2110 IP video device as channels.
st2110inTOP: Receives uncompressed video over IP following the SMPTE ST 2110 standard.
st2110outTOP: Transmits uncompressed video over IP following the SMPTE ST 2110 standard.
stretchCHOP: Stretches or compresses channels to a new length while preserving their shape.
subdividePOP: Subdivides point geometry for higher resolution.
substanceTOP: Renders a Substance (.sbsar) procedural material, exposing its published parameters.
subtractTOP: Subtracts the second input's pixels from the first.
switchCHOP: Selects one of several inputs by index.
switchPOP: Selects one of several point inputs by index.
switchTOP: Passes through one of several inputs chosen by an index, for A/B switching and sequencing.
syncoutCHOP: Coordinates frame synchronization across multiple machines.
syphonspoutinTOP: Receives a shared GPU texture via Syphon (macOS) or Spout (Windows).
syphonspoutoutTOP: Publishes the image as a shared GPU texture via Syphon (macOS) or Spout (Windows).
tableDAT: A static, editable grid of cells; its cell and fill expression parameters are withheld from this data-only surface.
tabletCHOP: Reads pen pressure, tilt, and position from a graphics tablet.
tcpipDAT: A TCP/IP client or server exchanging text messages.
textDAT: Holds free-form text, often used to store shader or script source referenced by other operators.
textSOP: Creates 3D text geometry from a font and string.
textTOP: Renders text into an image with control over font, size, alignment, and color.
texturemapPOP: Assigns or computes texture coordinates for points.
timeCOMP: Defines an independent local timeline (frame rate and range) for a subnetwork.
timecodeCHOP: Represents a timecode value as hour/minute/second/frame channels.
timelineCHOP: Outputs the current timeline position in frames and seconds.
timerCHOP: A programmable timer with segments, cycles, and done pulses for sequencing.
topologyPOP: Builds or edits the connectivity/topology of point geometry.
toptoCHOP: Samples pixels from a TOP into channels.
toptoPOP: Creates points from a TOP, turning pixels into positioned points.
torusPOP: Generates points arranged on a torus.
touchinCHOP: Receives channels from another TouchDesigner instance over the network.
touchinTOP: Receives an image from another TouchDesigner instance over the network.
touchoutCHOP: Sends channels to another TouchDesigner instance over the network.
touchoutTOP: Sends the image to another TouchDesigner instance over the network.
tracePOP: Traces an image's shapes into points or curves.
trailCHOP: Displays a scrolling history graph of its input channels for monitoring.
trailPOP: Records the motion trails of points over time.
transformTOP: Translates, rotates, scales, and tiles the image within its frame.
trigPOP: Applies trigonometric functions to point attributes.
triggerCHOP: Generates an attack-decay-sustain-release envelope each time the input crosses a threshold.
trimCHOP: Trims channels to a start and end time.
tubePOP: Generates points arranged as a tube.
twistPOP: Applies twist, bend, or taper deformations to points.
udpinDAT: Receives UDP datagrams as table rows.
underTOP: Composites the second input over the first (the reverse of Over).
usdCOMP: Imports a Universal Scene Description (USD) scene.
videodeviceinTOP: Captures live video from a camera or capture card.
videodeviceoutTOP: Outputs the image to an SDI/HDMI or other hardware video device.
videodevicesDAT: Lists the available video capture devices.
videostreaminTOP: Receives a compressed video stream such as RTSP, RTMP, or SRT.
viosoTOP: Applies a VIOSO projection warp-and-blend calibration for multi-projector alignment.
waveCHOP: Generates periodic waveforms defined by shape and period; its expression-carrying parameter is withheld from this data-only surface.
webclientDAT: Issues HTTP requests and captures the responses.
webrenderTOP: Renders a web page or URL into an image using an embedded browser.
webrtcDAT: Handles WebRTC signaling and data-channel messaging.
webserverDAT: Hosts an HTTP and WebSocket server for external clients.
websocketDAT: A WebSocket client or server for bidirectional messaging.
windowCOMP: Defines an output window or fullscreen display on a chosen monitor.
xmlDAT: Parses XML or HTML into a navigable table.
freedinCHOP: Receives FreeD camera-tracking data (position/orientation/lens) over the network -- the open protocol for virtual-production and AR camera tracking.
stypeinCHOP: Receives live camera-tracking data from a Stype system over the network for virtual production.
mosysCHOP: Receives live camera-tracking data from a Mo-Sys StarTracker system over the network.
ncamCHOP: Receives live camera-tracking data from an Ncam system over the network.
renderstreaminTOP: Receives video frames from disguise RenderStream -- the inbound half of the disguise media-server bidirectional loop.
renderstreamoutTOP: Sends rendered frames back to disguise via RenderStream -- the outbound half of the bidirectional loop.
syncinCHOP: Receives multi-machine frame-sync timing over the network -- the receive half of a render-node cluster's software genlock (pairs with syncoutCHOP).
tileTOP: Tiles, repeats, crops and flips an input image into a grid -- fine checkerboards, LED pixel-map tiling, and test patterns.
pointtransformTOP: Applies a 3D transform, or an align-to-reference, to position/vector data stored in a TOP -- point-cloud alignment in texture space.
orbbecTOP: Captures colour/depth/IR image streams from an Orbbec depth sensor (TD's current-generation depth camera).
orbbecselectTOP: Selects one stream (colour/depth/IR/point) from an Orbbec depth sensor.
realsenseTOP: Captures colour/depth/IR image streams from an Intel RealSense depth sensor.
kinectazureTOP: Captures colour/depth/IR image streams from an Azure Kinect depth sensor.
kinectazureCHOP: Reads body-tracking, IMU and device channels from an Azure Kinect sensor.
